newsitem.title: USA: Texas legislator elected to U.S. Congress.
newsitem.headline: Texas legislator elected to U.S. Congress.

text.p: State legislator Ciro Rodriguez won a runoff election on Saturday to replace the late Representative Frank Tejeda in the U.S. House of Representatives.
Rodriguez beat challenger Juan Solis by 67-33 percent, with just 9 percent of 330,000 registered voters in the 28th Congressional District going to the polls, election officials said.
Both men were Democrats campaigning in the heavily Hispanic district, which stretches from San Antonio deep into southern Texas.
Rodriguez is currently a member of the Texas House of Representatives.
Tejeda, also a Democrat, died on Jan. 30 of brain cancer.
